forWhat: Every child whose parent report is not up to date. Out of date first, then written and waiting for approval, then not written yet.
A report is written from the answers an educator signed off, and an educator approves it before a parent reads it.

layout.shows: [[Every class]], then one choice per class.
How many are out of date, to approve and to write.
Child, Class, Roll, Report and Written. A name opens the report.

jobs.title: Write and approve a parent report
steps: Press [[Write the report]], or [[Write it again]] if it is out of date.
Read it. To change it, press [[Edit the words]], then [[Save my version]].

buttons.label: Write the report
buttons.does: Writes a draft from the child's signed off answers.

buttons.label: Save my version
buttons.does: Saves your words after they are checked against the child's answers.

buttons.label: Approve for …'s parents
buttons.does: Approves the report so a parent can read it.
